snippet.title: Super Mega Runners
snippet.description:
Android http://goo.gl/UHMCyx iPhone http://goo.gl/d8wfjb
Retro style run and jump game! 
Simple controls! Lots of fun! 
Reach the goal with your super mega runner! 

■Run and Jump! 
Tap quickly for a little jump. 
Tap and hold for a higher jump. 
Master the jump technique to clear the athletic stages! 

■Power-Ups! 
Hit and destroy "!" blocks for special items. 
Get mega big with a strawberry and destroy everything on your way, or get extra rich with a banana! 

■Mega Runners! 
President Abe, Army Guy, Mister Tee, and more! 
Each runner has their own characteristics! 

■Upcoming Updates! 
-Additional characters! 
-Play user stages, or create and share yours! 

Stay tuned for new features and contents in the upcoming updates! (^o^)/ 


Character Design

- Ty Lettau http://goo.gl/c2xjas
